name: The Edit: Nested Images
description: An edit template where images nest inside each other in a layered collage-like layout. Good for editorial and fashion content with a high-design aesthetic.

name: The Route: Destinations Carousel
description: An animated carousel template showing travel destinations along a route. Good for travel app showcases and destination discovery features.

name: The Route: Destinations Map
description: An animated map template where routes draw themselves between locations. Great for travel app showcases and content where the geography itself is part of the story.

name: The Route: New Destination
description: A template where a route path extends to reveal a new destination. Good for travel app feature launches and destination reveals.

name: The Stack: Livestream
description: An animated livestream announcement template with bold motion. Good for live event promotions and streaming content that needs to feel immediate.

name: The Stack: Partnership
description: An animated partnership announcement template with a polished card reveal. Ideal for collaboration announcements and co-brand social content.

name: The Stack: Release Notes
description: An animated release notes template that presents product updates as a stack of cards. A more visual alternative to a static changelog post.

name: The Stack: Sale
description: An animated sale announcement template with stacked card reveals and animated pricing. Good for e-commerce promotions and retail social content.

name: The Stack: Testimonial
description: An animated testimonial template that reveals quotes as a stack of cards one at a time. A more engaging alternative to a static quote graphic for social media or marketing videos.

name: The Stack: We're Hiring
description: An animated hiring announcement template with a polished card reveal. Good for employer branding and recruitment social content that wants to stand out from a plain text post.

name: HomePod mini [Apple Event]
description: An animated HomePod mini template in the style of an Apple keynote. Good for smart home product showcases and Apple ecosystem content.

name: iMac Cascade [Apple Event]
description: A template where an iMac cascades into frame in Apple event style. Ideal for desktop product showcases and tech brand presentations.

name: Magic Keyboard Specs [Apple Event]
description: An animated spec sheet template for the Magic Keyboard in Apple event style. Good for hardware showcases and tech product presentations.

name: Sliding Blocks [Apple Event]
description: A template where blocks slide into position in the style of an Apple keynote. Good for product announcement slides and tech event presentations.
